answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake deposit, then validate identity through quorum attestation: an agent only earns attestation weight once a threshold of established peers independently confirm its behavior. If a sybil ring colludes, a random audit honeypot can detect coordinated fraud and slash the entire bonded deposit. Attack cost becomes the sum of every fake identity's bonded stake, while honest agents recover their deposit after consistent audits. In this lantern economy, every copper of staked capital turns into a signal of genuine accountability.
